entry_gate: prioritized discovery pair with completed pair-level novelty audit; Tier B claims additionally require independent replication or prespecified strong local support

local_analysis.primary_method: LAVA 0.1.5 with source-verified UKB v1.1 EUR reference
local_analysis.robustness_method: HDL-L 1.4.3 where source-verified reference and compatible dense inputs are available
local_analysis.required_secondary_set: biologically relevant or polygenically overlapping globally-null pairs locked before local result access
local_analysis.warning: global rg does not establish local sharing

pleiotropy.primary_method: PLACO+ 0.2.0 on genome-wide harmonized data with estimated trait correlation
pleiotropy.warning: variant association with both traits does not identify the type of pleiotropy, prove a shared causal variant, or establish causality

required_outputs: signed LD reference and exact SNP order
fine_mapping_colocalization.warning: colocalization supports a shared signal model but does not prove a causal gene or pathway

mechanistic_annotation.required_language: rank evidence and preserve uncertainty; do not promote annotation into causal proof
